name: io.github.jgt87/copilot-studio-mcp
title: Copilot Studio MCP
description: Build, test, ship and maintain Microsoft Copilot Studio agents from the editor

environmentVariables.name: CPS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Agent workspace folder to start in (VS Code: ${workspaceFolder})

environmentVariables.name: CPS_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Entra tenant id for cs_login; defaults to organizations

environmentVariables.name: CPS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your own app registration for cs_login; defaults to the first-party VS Code client id

environmentVariables.name: CPS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to withhold every tool that can change an environment

environmentVariables.name: CPS_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tool preset or glob list: core, authoring, admin, solutions, full
